caption: The video captures a wide, calm lake under an overcast sky, framed by a white dock railing along the left and a sliver at the right edge. A dense reed clump rises from the water at left of center, crossed by a thin diagonal pole, against a tree-covered shoreline horizon. A single dark waterbird floats on the open water at right-center. Throughout the bird drifts slowly and steadily leftward toward the center, trailing a faint horizontal wake to its right. The camera holds fixed, so the railing, pole tip, and distant houses keep their positions, marking the bird's shift as true motion across the still surface. Minor ripples and the reed reflection distort gently, but nothing enters or leaves the view.
relations: The dark waterbird drifts steadily leftward across the still surface, leaving a faint horizontal wake trailing to its right.
Fixed camera keeps the white railing, diagonal pole tip, and distant shoreline houses anchored while the bird shifts.
Minor ripples and the reed clump's reflection distort gently around the moving bird without new objects entering view.
